SPORTS AND RECREATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: SPORTS AND RECREATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. The ticket price

2. Best practice when working on Basic Elements of Sports Coaching: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Basic Elements of Sports Coaching.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Basic Elements of Sports Coaching.
   C. Damage equipment used for Basic Elements of Sports Coaching.
   D. Practise Basic Elements of Sports Coaching with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation.

   C. Refuse all feedback on Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll.
   D. Practise Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Officiating Athletics III Enforcing the Rules of athletics III: (1 mark)

   D. Disrupt classmates during Officiating Athletics III Enforcing the Rules of athletics III.

6. Best practice when working on Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W: (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W.
   D. Practise Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Exercise and Nutrition requirements: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Exercise and Nutrition requirements with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Exercise and Nutrition requirements.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Exercise and Nutrition requirements.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Exercise and Nutrition requirements.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

10. Best practice when working on Management of Sports Activities: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Management of Sports Activities.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Management of Sports Activities.

11. Best practice when working on Talent Exposure and Monetization Talent exposure: (1 mark)

12. Best practice when working on Game officials: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Game officials with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Game officials.

   D. Refuse all feedback on Game officials.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Basic Elements of Sports Coaching and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Sports Activities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Tactical Skills and Formations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
